textedit: Before editing a document's text, read its full current contents and preserve every character, including trailing whitespace and line breaks; never retype the content from memory.
Always ensure the document ends with a trailing newline when the required format specifies one, and verify the saved file content matches the expected format exactly before finishing.
Always ensure the document ends with a trailing newline after the final line before saving, since the checker requires each line to be newline-terminated.
calculator: When an expression mixes addition and multiplication, press Equals after the addition to resolve that part before entering the multiplication, or otherwise ensure the grouping you intend is actually applied.
